description: Get one UX/UI principle by slug: title, code, part, difficulty, summary, the bibliographic citations behind it (author, title, year, url) and the link to the full guide on uxuiprinciples.com. With UXUI_API_KEY set (pro mode) the full guide body comes back in `content`. Use it to identify, summarize or cite a specific principle; use search_principles first when you only have a topic.

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

slug.description: The principle slug as returned by search_principles or list_principles (e.g., "cognitive-load", "hicks-law", "fitts-law").

name: get_principle
title: Get a principle
